thesis: Hold at the 11:30 ET tick. Sizing book is one name: VTI about $249 (~25% of ~$999 equity) and cash about $750 (~75%), inside the 15% cash floor, 35% single-name cap, and 6-position limit. Items published after 15:00Z and before the 15:30Z cutoff are not rotation catalysts: a labor-market piece says job openings are low and hiring is weak, with war, high gas prices, rising rates, and AI capping job creation; a Medicare Advantage note says plans will be cheaper next year but names no issuer and gives no premium figure ahead of Oct. 15 enrollment; Fidelity Core Real Estate Fund filed an 8-K (Items 2.02 and 7.01) with no results in the summary; Treasure Global filed a material agreement plus an unregistered equity sale, which is microcap dilution rather than a balanced add. Carryover regime stays cautious: junk bonds on track for their worst month since 2022, the 10-year at 5.268% (+0.028pt) with TLT down 0.86%, oil and USO weaker, and VIX at 16.08 essentially flat. The existing VTI sleeve already expresses large-cap quality ballast. This tick supplies no quantified catalyst to add a second name, add duration into rising yields, buy oil on a down print, or resize VTI.
